newsitem.title: USA: Overseas Filmgroup will report net loss.
newsitem.headline: Overseas Filmgroup will report net loss.

text.p: Overseas Filmgroup Inc says it will report a net loss of $1.5 million for 1996, primarily resulting from an expected one-time, non-recurring deferred federal tax charge of approximately $2.6 million.

The tax charge is due to the company's conversion from "S" Corporation to "C" Corporation status, effective upon the consummation of the October 1996 business combination of the independent motion picture distribution company, Overseas Filmgroup Inc, and the specified purpose acquisition company, Entertainment/Media Acquisition Corp which created Overseas Filmgroup Inc.
The company had pro forma net income of approximately $1.7 million in 1995.
The company expects revenues for the year ended December 31, 1996 to approximate $28.7 million, as compared to $21.7 million in 1995.
Income from operations for 1996 is expected to approximate $1.6 million, as compared to income from operations of approximately $2.6 million in 1995.
Overseas Filmgroup is an independent motion picture distribution company specializing in the acquisition and worldwide distribution of independently produced feature films.
